recordedAtUtcSource: system clock, read after the re-proof validate exited and the sampler stopped

originalValidation.note: this re-proof is a separate owner-authorised run; it proves nothing retrospectively about the three processes the first run saw

a3.source: explicit owner confirmation (AskUserQuestion answer "Confirmed quiesced"), established anew before the quiet period; no A3 execution during the re-proof

samplerDesign.snapshot: one atomic process-table read per poll (ps -axww -o pid,ppid,pgid,sess,lstart,command, a single kernel KERN_PROC_ALL read) plus one lsof cwd read for the candidate PIDs; every poll stores observation time, the governed root identity, every candidate with its full same-snapshot PPID chain, and the whole governed tree

governedRoot.role: the governed re-proof wrapper script; it ran the quiet gate and then launched caffeinate -dimsu npm run validate as its own child
governedRoot.identity: pid + process start time (guards against PID reuse)

samplerDesign.candidatePredicate: monitor v3, unchanged: command matches vitest | npm run validate | npm run test | npm test | a3prep (the monitor itself excluded) AND cwd or command lies in this engine repository or a worktree. Nothing is whitelisted by command text
samplerDesign.ancestryRule: GOVERNED_VALIDATION_DESCENDANT_PROVED only when the same-snapshot PPID chain reaches the governed root identity, or the same pid+start identity sat inside the governed tree at an earlier poll. Otherwise ANCESTRY_NOT_PROVED (started after the root) or EXTERNAL_COMPETING_PROCESS; both count as competing. PGID, SID, cwd, command and timing are recorded as supporting evidence only
samplerDesign.selfTest: before use, verified against scratch processes: a direct child classified GOVERNED_VALIDATION_DESCENDANT_PROVED, a double-forked orphan reparented to launchd classified ANCESTRY_NOT_PROVED

validation.tests: 209 files passed, 5 skipped; 5267 tests passed, 75 skipped

candidateSummary.observation: the short-lived node --require <worktree>/node_modules/vitest/suppress-warnings.cjs processes (the shape the first run could not attribute) recurred throughout this run; every one was caught while its chain still ran through vitest -> npm test -> validate -> the governed wrapper

landedEvaluator.input: one sample per poll, competingProcessCount = candidates not GOVERNED_VALIDATION_DESCENDANT_PROVED
